title: Invite 30 Active Members
description: Apne referral link se 30 naye active members ko join karwayein jo apna account verify karein. Jitni jaldi 30 members ki team mukammal karenge, utni hi jaldi next update mein naye features launch honge aur aap mazeed coins kama sakenge!
requirement: Team tree section ka screenshot support handler ko bhejein jismein 30 active members show ho rahe hon, taake aapke coins add kiye ja sakein aur naye features unlock ho sakein.

title: K-Drama Hub Explorer
description: Jald araha hai 'K-Drama Hub' (Next Update)! 30 members ki team complete karwayein taake jaise hi target poora ho, yeh feature app mein launch ho aur aap dramas dekh kar coins jeet sakein.
requirement: Pehle 30 active members ki adding mukammal karke support ko screenshot bhejein taake 'K-Drama Hub' launch kiya ja sake.

title: Movie Box Critic
description: Jald araha hai 'Movie Box' (Next Update)! Apni team strong karein taake nayi movies aur short clips dekh kar coins collect karne ka feature jald launch ho.
requirement: 30 members adding ka target achieve karein aur support ko proof dein taake 'Movie Box' feature app mein live ho.

title: Audio Playable Listener
description: Jald araha hai 'Audio Playable' section (Next Update)! Target poora karein aur aane walay audio tracks aur podcasts par coins earn karne ki tayari karein.
requirement: 30 members ki team complete karwayein taake 'Audio Playable' section jald update mein add kiya ja sake.

title: Game Station Challenger
description: Jald araha hai 'Game Station' (Next Update)! Referral network mazboot karein taake jab casual games launch hon toh aap games khel kar dher saare coins kama sakein.
requirement: 30 members add karwane ki requirement poori karein taake 'Game Station' ka feature jald live ho sake.

title: ProJoin Voice Review
description: ProJoin app ke bare mein apna qeemti review voice note mein record karke admin/support ko bhejein aur coins hasil karein.
requirement: Apna voice review WhatsApp handler ko send karein aur confirmation screenshot dein.

title: TikTok 3 Members Challenge
description: TikTok ke zariye ProJoin par 3 naye active members ko join karwayein aur baray coins jeetein.
requirement: TikTok se aane wale members ki list ya team tree ka screenshot admin ko bhejein.

title: Multi-Platform Status Share
description: Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Facebook, ya WhatsApp par ProJoin ka status lagayein aur coins collect karein.
requirement: Kisi bhi platform par status lagane ka screenshot support handler ko bhejein.

title: Free Fire Solo Session (100 Coins)
description: Free Fire game ko install karke kam az kam 5 minute tak akele ya doston ke sath kheleing aur coins jeetein.
requirement: Free Fire ki gameplay screen ya profile ka screenshot support par share karein (Sir ke sath na khelne par).

title: Free Fire with Sir Owner (200 Coins)
description: Sir Owner ke sath Free Fire game join karein aur kam az kam aik match mukammal khel kar 200 coins jeetein!
requirement: Sir Owner ke sath aik match ki gameplay ya lobby screen ka screenshot support ko bhejein.

title: Sir Owner Prank Master
description: Sir Owner ke sath koi mazedaar prank karein aur unke sath chat ka screenshot share karein.
requirement: Sir Owner ke sath prank chat ya reaction ka screenshot bhejein.

title: 5000 Coins Milestone Gift
description: Agar aapke account mein total 5000 coins ho chuke hain, toh yeh special milestone gift claim karein!
requirement: Apne dashboard par 5000 coins ka balance show hone ka screenshot support ko bhejein.
